Open the front service door. ae If the game was pre-installed at the factory, proceed to line 9. : Place cassette tape in the cassette deck, See Figure l, game package installation. Install key module. See Figure 2, game package installation. Adjust dipswitches to desired settings. See Figure 3, and please refer to the game package dipswitch setting sheet. Install game top flashing. Turn power switch on, located at the front of the machine. Allow 2-3 minutes for the game to load the memory. The game is now ready for operation. * If the game has any irregularities, refer to the system trouble shooting guide on the next pages. Figure 1 Figure 2 Figure 3 -1-
